from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Static word meanings fail to capture context.",
            "LSTMs process sequentially, often losing context.",
            "Attention weighs word importance dynamically."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Problem: Static vs. Dynamic Meaning", lecture_lines)
        
        # Assets
        scales_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scales.svg")
        compass_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg")
        
        static_word = Text("Word", color="#FF5733")
        dynamic_word = Text("Word", color="#33FF57")
        attention_label = Text("Attention", color=WHITE)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        self.place_at_grid(static_word, "B4", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(scales_icon, "B2", scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(static_word), FadeIn(scales_icon))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        lstm_box = Rectangle(width=2, height=1, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(lstm_box, "C4", "D5", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.add(lstm_box)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#33FF57"))
        self.place_at_grid(attention_label, "E5", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(compass_icon, "E3", scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(
            FadeIn(attention_label), 
            FadeIn(compass_icon),
            ReplacementTransform(static_word, dynamic_word.move_to(static_word.get_center()))
        )
        self.wait(1)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):

            "Keys act like labels on books.",
            "Values contain the actual information retrieved."
        ])

        query = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=1.5, color="#FFD700", fill_opacity=0.6)

        value = Rectangle(height=0.8, width=1.5, color="#FF69B4", fill_opacity=0.6)

        self.place_at_grid(q_label, 'A2', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(query), Write(q_label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))
        self.place_in_area(key, 'A4', 'A6', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(k_label, 'A5', scale_factor=0.5)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Calculating Attention Scores", [
            "Dot-product measures similarity between vectors.",
            "Softmax converts scores to probability weights.",
            "Weights sum to one across context."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Q * K^T visualization
        matrix_q = Matrix([["q1"], ["q2"]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]")
        matrix_k = Matrix([["k1", "k2"]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]")
        eq = MathTex(r"Q \cdot K^T = \text{Score}")
        
        icon_vec = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg")
        
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_q, "B2", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(matrix_k, "B4", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_in_area(eq, "D2", "D4", scale_factor=1.0)
        self.place_at_grid(icon_vec, "A3", scale_factor=0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(matrix_q), FadeIn(matrix_k), FadeIn(eq), FadeIn(icon_vec))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.wait(1)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Heatmap intensity (simulated with colored squares)
        heatmap = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.6, fill_opacity=0.6, color=RED).shift(i*0.7*RIGHT + j*0.7*UP) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)])
        softmax_text = MathTex(r"\text{Softmax}(\text{Score})")
        icon_bar = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bar.svg")
        
        self.place_in_area(heatmap, "B5", "C6", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.place_at_grid(softmax_text, "D5", scale_factor=0.7)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["One head captures limited relationships.", "Multiple heads run in parallel.", "Each head learns different perspectives."]
        self.setup_layout("Multi-Head Attention: Seeing from Multiple Perspectives", lecture_lines)
        
        # Create base attention blocks
        def create_block(color):
            return Rectangle(width=1.5, height=0.8, fill_opacity=0.5, color=color, fill_color=color)

        heads = VGroup(
            create_block("#8A2BE2"),
            create_block("#FF4500"),
            create_block("#32CD32")
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)

        # Asset loading
        eye = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/eye.svg")
        prism = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        single_head = create_block("#8A2BE2")
        self.place_at_grid(single_head, "B2", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(FadeIn(single_head))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#8A2BE2"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(FadeOut(single_head))
        self.place_in_area(heads, "B3", "D4", scale_factor=0.6)
        eye.scale(0.5).next_to(heads, UP)
        self.play(FadeIn(heads), FadeIn(eye))
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF4500"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        concat_layer = Rectangle(width=5.0, height=0.5, fill_opacity=0.7, color=WHITE, fill_color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(concat_layer, "E4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        connections = VGroup()
        for head in heads:
            connections.add(Line(head.get_bottom(), concat_layer.get_top(), color=head.get_fill_color()))
            
        prism.scale(0.5).next_to(concat_layer, RIGHT)
        self.play(Create(concat_layer), Create(connections), FadeIn(prism))
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#32CD32"))
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read Context
outline.target_audience: University students with basic programming/linear algebra knowledge

sections.title: The Problem: Static vs. Dynamic Meaning
sections.content: Introduce the limitation of previous models (RNNs/LSTMs) that process words sequentially, losing context. Define the concept of 'Attention' as the ability to weigh the importance of different words in a sentence relative to each other.
sections.example: In the sentence 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired,' visual animation highlights 'it' connecting to 'animal', not 'street'.

sections.title: The Query-Key-Value (QKV) Framework
sections.content: Use the library analogy to explain QKV. A Query (what I'm looking for) matches against Keys (labels on books) to retrieve the Value (the information inside). Show a simplified matrix multiplication visual.
sections.example: Imagine a library: Your search term is the 'Query', the book titles on shelves are 'Keys', and the book content you choose to read is the 'Value'.

sections.title: Calculating Attention Scores (Mathematical Foundation)
sections.content: Explain the Dot-Product Attention: Score = Softmax((Q * K^T) / sqrt(d_k)). Explain that Q*K^T measures similarity, and the Softmax turns these into percentages (weights) that sum to 1.
sections.example: A heat map visual shows a 3x3 grid of colors; brighter squares indicate higher attention scores between word pairs (e.g., 'King' strongly attends to 'Man').

sections.title: Multi-Head Attention: Seeing from Multiple Perspectives
sections.content: Explain that one 'head' isn't enough. By running multiple attention processes in parallel, the model learns different types of relationships: grammar, gender, or temporal references simultaneously.
sections.example: Four different 'spotlight' beams hitting the same sentence, each highlighting different word connections (e.g., one beam for syntax, one for subject-verb agreement).

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Impact
sections.content: Summarize how these weighted context vectors allow LLMs to generate coherent, context-aware text. Highlight that this mechanism is the 'engine' behind the reasoning capabilities of GPT.
sections.example: Animation showing a chatbot taking an ambiguous input and, through the 'Attention' engine, successfully resolving the query into a precise, helpful response.
